name: Minority game: the real history against a random one
description: Does the minority game need its own history? σ²/N against memory for 101 players with 2 strategies, reading the real record of winning sides or a random one drawn each round. Measured (release, seeds 1–10, recorded 2026-09-27): 2.0/2.3, 1.4/1.3, 0.82/0.76, 0.37/0.37, 0.10/0.11, 0.060/0.060, 0.10/0.12, 0.15/0.15, 0.18/0.20, 0.22/0.24 at M 1 to 10 — the same curve: what matters is that everyone reads the same signal, not that it is the real one.
